content: Isirelibɑn yorun wɔ̃ɔ wɔkurusen suru wɔkurusen sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurɑ yiruse sɔɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u Esekiɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, ɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑ kisio Eɡibiti sunɔn mi ɡiɑ kpɑ ɑ wi, kɑ win temɡibu kpuro sɔ̃

ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, wee kon nùn wɔrimɑ wi, wi u sɑ̃ɑ nɡe kɑrɑku ɡe ɡɑ nɑnum mɔ ɡɑ kpĩ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Niluɔ. Mɑ u ɡerumɔ u mɔ̀, dɑɑ te, tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ wiɡiru domi wiyɑ u tu kuɑ.
Kon kɔkɔnu sɔre win bɑɑ sɑburosu sɔɔ kpɑ n de dɑɑ ten swɛ̃ɛ yi n sɔre sɔre win koko wɔrukisɔ. Kpɑ n nùn ɡɑwɑ n yɑrɑ dɑɑ ten min di kɑ swɛ̃ɛ yi sɑnnu.
Kpɑ n nùn suɑ n kɔ̃ ɡbɑburɔ kɑ swɛ̃ɛ yi kpuro. U koo wɔriwɑ yɑkɑsɔ. Goo kun nùn seeyɑmɔ, ɡoo kun mɑɑ nùn dɔbɑmɔ. Gbeeku yɛɛ kɑ ɡunɔsɑ su koo win ɡoru di.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Eɡibitiɡibu kpuro bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ. Domi somi te u Isirelibɑ kuɑ tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kɑbɑru, tɑ ǹ dɑm mɔ.
Bɑ nùn tɑ̃sisi mɑ u bɔɔrɑ ben nɔmɑɔ u ben senu mɛɛrɑ kuɑ mɑ u derɑ bɑ subɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, wee ye nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡerumɔ. Nɑ nɛɛ, kon de bu nùn wɔrimɑ kɑ tɑkobi kpɑ n de bu win tɔmbu kɑ yɛɛ kpuro ɡo.
Eɡibitin tem mu koo ko bɑnsu kpɑ bu ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ. Domi yen sunɔ u nɛɛ, wiyɑ u dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Nilu mɔ. Wiyɑ u mɑɑ be tu kuɑ.
Yen sɔ̃, kon wi kɑ win dɑɑ te wɔrimɑ. Kpɑ win tem mu ko bɑnsu sɑɑ Miɡidolin di n kɑ dɑ Asuɑniɔ kɑ Etiopin tem nɔɔ burɑ yenɔ.
Tɔnu kun mɑɑ sɑrɔ mi, mɛyɑ yɑɑ ɡɑɑ kun mɑɑ sɑrɔ mi. Yɑ koo kowɑ wɔ̃ɔ weeru ɡoo kun mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi.
Wɔ̃ɔ weerun bɑɑ sɔɔ, kon de Eɡibitin tem kɑ yen wusu su ko bɑnsu n kere bɑnsu kpuro. Kon bu yɑrinɑsiɑ n de bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bwese tukunun suunu sɔɔ.
Amɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ mɑɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, wɔ̃ɔ wee ten biru, kon Eɡibitiɡibu mɛnnɑmɑ bwese tukunun suunu sɔɔn di mi bɑ yɑrinɛ.
Be, Eɡibitiɡii be bɑ rɑɑ yoru dimɔ kon kɑ bu wurɑmɑ ben temɔ berɑ mi bɑ mɔ̀ Pɑturɔsi. Miyɑ bɑ koo bɑndu swĩi te tɑ ǹ dɑm mɔ.
Tɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɑn te tɑ piiburu bo kpɑ tɑ kun dɑm mɔ bwese ni nu tie sɔɔ. Kon tu kɑwɑwɑ kpɑ tu ku rɑɑ kɑ bwese ni nu tie tɑɑre.
Isirelibɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ tu nɑɑnɛ mɔ̀. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ dɔɔ ten mi, bu somiru kɑnɑ ye yɑ ko n sɑ̃ɑ ben durum. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ u koo Eɡibiti
tɑbu wɔri u mwɑ
Isirelibɑn yorun wɔ̃ɔ yɛndɑ nɔɔbu kɑ yirusen suru ɡbiikoon tɔ̃ɔ ɡbiikiru sɔɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,

tɔnun bii, wee Nɛbukɑnɛsɑɑ Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko u derɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ sɔm sɛ̃sɔɡinu kuɑ bu kɑ Tiri kɑmiɑ. Adɑmɑ win tɑbu kowo be kpuro bɑ wii kpɑki kuɑ mɑ ben senu potikirɑ. Kɑ mɛ, Bɑbilonin sinɑ bokon tii kɑ win tɑbu kowo be, bɑ ǹ ɑrufɑɑni ɡɑɑ wɑ sɔmbu te sɔɔ, te bɑ kuɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, kon Bɑbilonin sinɑ boko Eɡibitin dukiɑ kpuro wɛ̃. U koo ben yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ kpɑ nu n sɑ̃ɑ win tɑbu kowobun kɔsiɑru.
Kon nùn Eɡibiti wɛ̃wɑ yɑ n sɑ̃ɑ win sɔmbu te u kuɑn kɔsiɑru. Domi nɛnɑ, wi kɑ win sɔm kowobu bɑ sɔmburu kuɑ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, kon Isirelibɑ dɑm kɛ̃ kpɑ n mɑɑ wunɛ tɔnun biin nɔɔ wukiɑ ɑ kɑ bu ɡɑri ko kpɑ bu ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ
u koo Eɡibiti sɛɛyɑsiɑ
